Details.title: Details
Details.description: The full data-usage payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this: {"title":"Your data this cycle","cycleText":"12 days left · resets Sep 30","used":42.1,"total":50,"unit":"GB","categories":[{"label":"Streaming","amount":24.6},{"label":"Social","amount":9.8},{"label":"Other","amount":7.7}],"note":"You're on track to stay under your limit.","submitText":"Add a data pass","submitValue":"I'd like to add a data pass to my plan"} Rules: - 'title' (string, optional): heading at the top of the card. Defaults to 'Your usage'. - 'cycleText' (string, optional): the billing-cycle status line, e.g. '12 days left · resets Sep 30'. - 'used' (number, REQUIRED): amount consumed so far this cycle, in the same unit as 'total'. - 'total' (number, optional): the allowance. Omit it (or set 0) for an unlimited plan — the gauge then fills fully and shows 'Unlimited'. - 'unit' (string, optional): the unit of measure, e.g. 'GB','MB','min','texts'. Defaults to 'GB'. - 'categories' (array, optional, up to 6 objects): a usage breakdown shown as a stacked bar with a legend. Each object has 'label' (string), 'amount' (number, same unit), and optional 'color' (string, hex like '#0891b2'). Only categories with a positive amount are shown. - 'note' (string, optional): a short callout under the gauge, e.g. an overage warning or reassurance. It is automatically tinted amber near the limit and red when over. - 'submitText' (string, optional): label for an optional action button, e.g. 'Add a data pass' or 'Upgrade plan'. Omit to hide the button. - 'submitValue' (string, optional): the exact message sent back to you when the button is tapped; defaults to 'submitText'. The gauge turns amber at 80% of the allowance and red at or over 100%. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
